problem_context.problem_statement: Reverify the real CRTOS CircularAreaRead and its internal query/helper call chain after adopting the idmanager-style circular_area_state/store_circular_area resource. Remove CircularAreaBackingResource and all caller-visible ring representation witnesses from public and internal API contracts. The public Read contract must expose only the abstract circular state plus the caller-owned output-buffer state needed to describe bytes written.
problem_context.expected_behavior: On invalid output/null/zero-length or empty FIFO, return ERROR and preserve the circular state and any owned output buffer. On success, actual=min(requested,Zlength(ca_contents state)); copy the FIFO prefix into output[0..actual), drop that prefix from ca_contents, preserve capacity and all hidden backing/descriptor resources, set the hidden read index consistently and status to zero, and return EOK. Preserve exact CRTOS memcpy/wrap behavior and original function body.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Use store_circular_area state circular_area as the sole circular-area ownership at every public/internal call boundary. Define pure Read result/transition relations over circular_area_state and output contents in the case lib as needed. Output capacity/physical contents are legitimate caller-owned resources, but data_buffer/readidx/writeidx/status/operations/physical ring bytes must remain hidden inside store_circular_area. Init and Reset outputs must call Read without representation conversion.
spec_hint: Use one abstract state binder for the circular area. It is acceptable to bind output_capacity/output_before because they describe a separate caller buffer. Update the embedded CircularAreaIsFull/IsEmpty/GetDataLength/DivideRdData specs and callsite where clauses to consume and return the same store_circular_area state. Open the representation only with internal full Assert points required for field access/memcpy, following the Reset pattern. Do not weaken memcpy byte semantics and do not switch mixed_full to full.
preferred_hidden_properties: The Read post-state is directly consumable by Reset, queries, ordinary Write, force Write, Release and repeated Read; failed Read preserves exactly the input abstract state.

annotation_contract.ready_condition: agent_result.annotation.status == completed and ready_for_annotation_check_round == true only after canonical QCP, case_lib coqc, and annotation-checking pass; self_reworkable_failures must be empty
annotation_contract.blocked_condition: only phase skill hard blockers should use status == blocked; self_repair_budget_exhausted is work evidence, not an automatic blocked condition

mathematical_postconditions_required: Function specs must state what result the function computes, not only bounds or shape facts.
Loop invariants must connect processed state to the final mathematical postcondition.
avoid_spec_antipatterns: Do not weaken the spec to shape-only or bounds-only conditions.
Do not restate the C loops as the mathematical definition.
